I thought we could try a fun word puzzle together :)

I've got a Boggle board here:

ABRL
EITE
IONS
FPEI

I'd like to know the longest word that can be generated from the board. Please find the longest English language word that can be generated from this board. If more than one word of the same length exists at the maximum word length, please report the longest word that comes first, alphabetically. Oh, and I know that there might be different wordlists available for Boggle, so let's please just use the words_alpha dictionary found at https://github.com/dwyl/english-words as the dictionary for our game.

history.content:
Algorithm setup: We will use the words_dictionary.json (same content as words_alpha) as our dictionary source. Board letters and positions:
Row0: A(0,0) B(0,1) R(0,2) L(0,3)
Row1: E(1,0) I(1,1) T(1,2) E(1,3)
Row2: I(2,0) O(2,1) N(2,2) S(2,3)
Row3: F(3,0) P(3,1) E(3,2) I(3,3)
Adjacency is 8-directional; each cell used at most once. Letter multiset counts on board: A:1, B:1, R:1, L:1, E:3, I:3, T:1, O:1, N:1, S:1, F:1, P:1.
Plan:
- Prefilter dictionary by letter frequency not exceeding the board counts.
- Build a Trie of the filtered words (prefix pruning).
- DFS from each cell using adjacency, avoiding revisits, checking prefixes in Trie.
- Track longest word(s); tie-break by alphabetical order.

history.name: Assistant
history.content: Prefilter phase: Reject any word containing letters not on the board or exceeding counts (e.g., more than 1 T, more than 1 L, etc.). This removes many long words like "penetration" (needs two Ts) and others. Trie constructed from filtered subset. Proceeding with DFS search across the 4x4 grid with prefix-pruning.
